issue: transformers 5.x makes rope_scaling a property that rewrites rope_parameters, dropping rope_theta -> llama3 rope init got base=None
fix: in to_hf_config set rope_scaling first then rope_parameters (theta folded in) last, standardize, and assert theta survived

issue: no single-host torus mesh-graph descriptor exists for an 8x4 BH galaxy; every shipped one is multi-host and dies with 'Mesh 0 has 4 host ranks'
fix: default to the plain mesh descriptor + FABRIC_1D + Topology.Linear, and make the torus knob raise instead of silently running linear

issue: every donor KV cache hardcodes 1 KV head per chip; llama at 8 kv heads / tp4 needs 2 and nothing raises if the shape is wrong
fix: parametrized n_kv_local=num_kv_heads//tp and pinned it with a boundary test; update_padded_kv_cache is head-agnostic (8 heads PCC 0.99997)

why: Llama-3.1-8B has no QK-norm; the donor's per-head RMSNorm on Q/K has no counterpart

issue: rotary_embedding_llama and rotary_embedding_indexed consume META-interleaved tables, but the HF checkpoint and reference are half-split: PCC 0.75, nothing
fix: permute q/k projection rows HF->Meta at load (reverse_permute); scores are invariant since v and o are never rotated

issue: ring_joint SDPA rejects fp32_dest_acc_en=True on the cache-read path: kv_actual_isl needs the streaming compute path
fix: pinned RING_FP32_DEST_ACC=False after measuring it is worth only +7e-5 PCC on the no-cache path and is required for P2

issue: attention sits at PCC 0.9899, just under pcc_target 0.99, and it is not the bf8 weights: bf16 weights give 0.989887 vs bf8 0.989870
fix: attributed to the ring SDPA's bf16 dest accumulation, which the cache-read kernel forbids raising; accepted and recorded in README

issue: the on-device KV cache stores K in META head-dim order because q/k are permuted for the rope ops; an HF-order golden reads as uncorrelated (PCC 0.008)
fix: permute the golden K with hf_to_meta_head_dim before every KV comparison, including the P1/P2 golden-trace check

issue: rotary_embedding_llama does not check its cos/sin length against the input in prefill: a REPLICATED table rotates every SP row at positions 0..seq_local
fix: SP-shard the rope tables like the tokens (sp_shard_rope); KV went 0.59 -> 0.99994 while the logits check stayed at 1.0 either way

issue: the earlier attribution of attention PCC 0.9899 to ring-SDPA bf16 accumulation was wrong; the cause was the replicated rope tables
fix: with SP-sharded rope tables attention measures 1.000000, so the ring op's fp32 constraint costs nothing at all here

why: the checkpoint is unquantized bf16: there is no dequantization step, so there are no packed blocks or scales to verify

issue: full-depth one-shot KV: min K 0.994016 clears pcc_target but min V 0.980986 sits between target 0.99 and bound 0.85
fix: attributed to residual-stream error accumulation, not cache dtype: a bf16 cache gives an identical 0.980903, so bf8 quantization costs nothing

fix: reran uv pip install setuptools_scm==8.1.0 then uv pip install -e . --no-build-isolation; the venv is container-local and does not survive a reallocation

issue: P2 needs a trace of at least 2 spec chunks (10240 tok), and a full-depth fp16 CPU golden at that length takes hours
fix: ran full-depth chunked at 2x2560 over P1's own 5120 trace for an exact P1-vs-P2 comparison, with the spec-exact 2x5120 to follow
